title: Key the candidate population on CV identity, and refuse a second profile per CV
deviations_from_card: (1) The 409 carries the existing id as top-level `id` (jsonRefusal's `extra` convention, like maxBytes/field elsewhere), not `params:{id}`. (2) listProfileRecords returns the hash as a sibling `sourceCvHash` on the record, not on ProfileRow, so the roster's `.row` wire stays byte-identical; source_analysis_slug is not selected (nothing reads it). (3) The refusal is checked BEFORE the profile_cli spawn and again inside a new saveProfileForCv IMMEDIATE transaction (race-safe); the card only asked for a check before saveProfile. (4) Write set grew within the brief's allowance: candidateMatrixView.test.ts (fixture needs the new required `analyses`) and candidateMatrixContracts.test.ts (a source guard pinned the old `onBuildFromAnalysis(cand.slug)`; now pins the matrixChipAction path and still forbids the old defect), plus perf-budget.json under the lock. (5) Source-filter labels were not relabelled 'has a profile'/'analysis only'; the semantics hold (a merged row is source 'profile') and the doc says so. (6) Legacy duplicate profiles for one CV stay two rows (analyses attach to the newest); recorded as a Known gap.
notes: Cases 6 (cross-workspace -> 200) and 7 (persist:false preview -> 200) passed before the change: they are over-refusal guards, so red-before is 6 of 8. Those two cases spawn the real profile_cli (deterministic, <1s; CI's node job installs Python). api-response.ts: a sibling had GLYPH_UNKNOWN uncommitted in the working file, so my REFUSAL_ERRORS entry was committed via an index blob built from HEAD + my entry only (their line was left in their working copy; they have since committed it). Gates red on foreign work only: api:check blocks on undocumented /api/devcase/[id], /api/glyphs/[id], /api/pipeline/stage-sla (siblings); full test:unit had 1 failure, app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts (process-tree kill timing), which passes 3/3 run alone and touches nothing of mine (an earlier run also showed loading-gap-debt on devcases/DevTabCasesView.tsx, foreign). test:perf: my ~2 KB on db/profiles.ts + api-response.ts pushed jds/generate, tasks/[id]/retry and status letter over; I raised the group (3021->3023) and five overrides by 2 KB with a why (9bc5dcbd5). Still over by 1-2 KB after that: redraft 3038/3036, lifecycle approve 3033/3032, intake promote 3036/3035, interview-kit 3037/3036, from sibling in-flight work (staged app/_lib/db/devcase-ledger.ts + uncommitted devcase/pipeline-stages/aging-policy edits). The job-ingest 402/400 line was not present in these runs. The editor and the analysis report's save-as-profile banner render PROFILE_EXISTS through useErrorMessage but offer no 'open that profile' button (outside the write set; recorded as a Known gap in docs/features/candidates/README.md).
